purpose: Static educational close-view candidate; independent acceptance and publication separate.

criteria.description: Exact project/Khronos audit, editable source reopen, two separate-PID queued semantic rebuilds, real transformed dimensions, contact and global exposure.

All eight separate final512px views personally inspected; required diagnostic features readable and globally exposed. Cone shape and restrained recess are useful. Concept only visibly shows three spicules and makes bases blade-like; model exactly four thin approximately cylindrical faceted spicules, not blades, with all four attachments exposed. Three rim points retained. Exact dimensions come from frozen art parameters within published diagnosis, not from image pixels.

One low truncated cone with base wider than rim, three low rim nodes and shallow central recess. Four separate long ruler-straight thin spicules attached at the rim, radiating outward and down without crossings. No tentacles, dense spicule corona or deep osculum; no invented exact mineral composition. Idealized positive external form, not a replica of the negative-hyporelief mould. Four is a selected reconstruction count, not universal biology; sponge-grade affinity and composition remain interpretations. Primary-author2015 PNAS Fig3B shows holotype SAM P43257; Fig3A is labeled reconstruction.2012 publisher plate and supplement unavailable and not claimed viewed.
Complete original frozen brief/config/reference/concept preserved; exact dependency closure, counts and real measurements.
Exact GLB successfully parsed through pinned Three.js GLTFLoader.
Actual device-renderer evidence required; CPU proof does not pass this stage.
Actual composed intended scene evidence required; unrun stays unknown.
